newsitem.title: USA: Amoco to sign exploration contract.
newsitem.headline: Amoco to sign exploration contract.

text.p: Amoco North Apsheron Petroleum Ltd, a affiliate of Amoco Corp, said in a release received here said it will sign a contract on Saturday in Baku, Azerbaijan, to explore in the Caspian Sea.
The contract area, east of the Aspheron Peninsula, has identified prospects known as Ashrafi and Dan Ulduzu.

Amoco will have a 30 percent interest in Ashrafi/Dan Ulduzu. Unocal Corp will have 25.5 percent; Delta Oil Co, 4.5 percent; Itochu Warehouse, 20 percent; and the State Oil Co of Azerbaijan, 20 percent.

Amoco already is a 17.01 percent interest holder in the Azerbaijan International Operating Co, which is charged with developing three fields south of the Ashrafi/Dan Ulduzu area. That contract was signed in September 1994, and oil production is scheduled to begin in August of 1997.

The contract to be signed December 14 requires bonus payments of $75 million to the Azerbaijan government, depending on successful completion of various phases of the project. The contract area covers 453 square kilometers. Water depths in the area range from 75 to 200 meters.
